Disjoint 12 spherical caps give an exact upper-tail formula on a positive interval. Silhouette type follows local chamber sign incidence. Standalone standard-library checker verified exact tables and 2,900 numerical diagnostics and 3 local quadratures. Finite checks supplement, do not replace proof.
